title: Shelly 3EM Circuit Power Draw Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shelly:3em power_w=*
| stats sum(power_w) as total_value, avg(power_w) as avg_value by circuit_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks circuit values by total and average power draw across Shelly 3EM circuit events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_w` values for each Shelly 3EM circuit event and review total and average power draw by circuit.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total power draw.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly which circuit shows the biggest power draw numbers in your Shelly 3EM circuit data.
